definitions.explanation: A person who holds a position of authority in an organization, company, or association. Includes directors, officers, and committee members.

examples.japanese: {役員|やくいん}{会議|かいぎ}が{始|はじ}まる。
{彼|かれ}は{会社|かいしゃ}の{役員|やくいん}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: He was chosen as a company executive.

examples.japanese: PTA の{役員|やくいん}は{毎年|まいとし}{交代|こうたい}するので、{今年|ことし}は{私|わたし}の{番|ばん}になった。
examples.english: The PTA officers rotate every year, so this year it became my turn.

notes:
{役員|やくいん} refers to people in leadership or governing positions in organizations.

FORMS:
{役|やく} (role, duty) + {員|いん} (member)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役員|やくいん}{会議|かいぎ}: board meeting
- {役員|やくいん}{報酬|ほうしゅう}: executive compensation
- {役員|やくいん}を{務|つと}める: to serve as an officer
- {役員|やくいん}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to take office as an executive

USAGE:
Used for corporate executives ({取締役|とりしまりやく}), committee officers (PTA, neighborhood associations), and organizational leaders.
